o.text: From Persian باغبان (bâġbân). By surface analysis, bağ + -ban.

Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish یساغ (yasağ), from Middle Mongol ᠵᠠᠰᠠᠭ (ǰasaɣ), whence Mongolian засаг (zasag, “rule, power; law”) and Mongolian засах (zasax, “to fix, repair”); ultimately from Proto-Common Turkic *yasa- (“determine, govern; create”). Cognate with Turkish yasak (“prohibition”).
From Middle Mongol ᠵᠡᠪᠰᠡᠭ (ǰebseg), cognate with Mongolian зэвсэг (zevseg, “weapon”).
